top_strength: Nicole gathered all necessary logistics details methodically (two-story to one-story, square footage, special items, box count, parking, drive time, appliances) without customer pushback, establishing a complete and accurate foundation for the estimate.
coaching_note: Step 2 was skipped entirely — the rep never asked the two-concerns question (time-on-arrival and damage) that should open this section and frame the promises that follow. This is the bookend that the customer remembers, and jumping straight to logistics probing left money and trust on the table.
